jurisdiction.text: US policy jurisdiction (BankingRelationship.policyJurisdiction), not the booking jurisdiction.

screening_threshold.text: Same possible-match score as the synthetic bank (owner input D01); candidate until the firm's owner sets its own.

ownership_threshold.text: FinCEN CDD rule: each individual owning, directly or indirectly, 25 percent or more of the equity interests of a legal entity customer.

sanctions_ownership.text: OFAC 50 Percent Rule: property of an entity owned 50 percent or more, in the aggregate, by one or more blocked persons is blocked.

control_bases.text: FinCEN CDD rule control prong: an individual with significant responsibility to control, manage or direct the legal entity customer.

sanctions_control_bases.text: Majority voting control by a designated person always counts as sanctions control.

verification_methods.text: Firm appetite: a registry extract for institutional clients and a government identity document for their individuals.

active_registry_statuses.text: Only an active registration verifies legal existence (canonical status vocabulary, upper case).

freshness_seconds.text: List freshness 1 day and identity verification 90 days, as for the synthetic bank.

required_screening_types.text: Firm appetite: a custodian holds the client's assets, so negative news about the client is searched before onboarding. Firm appetite: wealth managed on a client's behalf is searched for negative news about the client first.

required_screening_lists.text: OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List.

screening_roles.text: An authorised trader or attorney can place orders and move securities on the account, so is screened.

pep_scope.text: Foreign political exposure at minimum; jurisdictions widen it.

required_party_roles.text: FinCEN CDD rule: identify and verify the beneficial owners of a legal entity customer.

dual_control_required.text: Firm appetite: two people approve every onboarding decision.

automatic_approval_enabled.text: No pack approves a customer without a person.

automatic_decline_enabled.text: No pack declines a customer without a person.

diligence_floors.text: No floor: a cell's level comes from the institution's diligence matrix. Layers may only raise floors (keys are customer type or *, then product or *).

mandatory_overlays.text: No overlay is mandatory everywhere; layers add the escalations their regulator requires.

simplified_due_diligence_permitted.text: Firm decision pending: simplified due diligence is not adopted until the policy owner approves where it applies.

knownDifferences.text: US law has no general PEP screening requirement outside private banking for senior foreign political figures (31 CFR 1010.620); PEP screening comes from the institution layer.
